profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.jobTitle: Sr Lead Software Engineer at Anthem AI

positions.title: Sr Lead Software Engineer at Anthem AI
Software Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented single page application architecture and design system components with JavaScript, React, Redux, Node.js and additional technologies as necessary.

- Collaborated with developers to establish strategy for coding standards, cross browser compliance, code organization, and architectural design and documentation for key features and independent apps.

- Built engaging and responsive visual experiences with JavaScript, SCSS/CSS, and HTML and worked in close collaboration with Design and Product teams to reach time-sensitive goals.

- Focused on Test-Driven Development and implemented guidelines for code consistency, readability, maintainability unit tests for functional components using Mocha and Chai.

- Integrated Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics throughout Gartner.com to track user behaviors to provide more accurate curated research documents to clients and increase user engagement.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked in an Agile engineering team to migrate legacy Gartner.com into responsive, interactive features using React, Redux, Node.js, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.

- Created multiple key features and components for Gartner.com Reader to increase client experience and engagement rate using React, Redux and Node.js.

- Followed and implemented WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) throughout Gartner.com Reader, Homepage Feed, and Login pages to ensure they are accessible by everyone.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Developed and improved analytic tools and platform to simulate sales lift and return on investment for promotional activities with market dynamics and intelligence.

- Forecasted and developed reports & data analysis of monthly sell-out costs by department, account and product.

- Developed sell-out Rolling Plan with forecasted costs vs actual results to provide insights on sales and promotional activities to upper management.

- Managed and created all promotional sell-out requests/programs in internal system.

positions.title: Business Development Intern
positions.description:
- Conducted research project on 3D printing to provide insights on Doosan Heavy Industries’ business opportunities with 3D printing to the executives

- Created data visualizations with statistical data such as market size, 3D printing revenue by industry breakdown, number of companies applying 3D printing technology, etc. with Tableau in order to visually identify the key insights and correlations between values  

- Assembled summaries and reports of researched data on PowerPoint in order to deliver thorough observations and proposals to the manager for the research project

- Presented key findings and solution of applying SLS (Selective Laser Sintering) 3D printing technology to its gas turbine and fuel nozzles in front of the executives to help them make data-driven strategic decisions

positions.title: Business Management and Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated in a team of 3 to research and analyze the company’s management processes and technology systems to identify possible improvements for its existing operation

- Researched and analyzed the aerospace and defense industry of various middle eastern countries and their economics to provide insight on contract regulations to HR department

- Analyzed the capabilities of a newly developed missile through analyzing quantitative data such as duration time, speed, explosion range, etc. using SPSS at the missile testing site

positions.title: Product Assurance Intern
positions.description:
- Supported SK Telecom’s PBB Project in developing a new business strategy through risk analysis using Excel

- Collaborated in a group of 3 to analyze newly developed computer network systems and utilized it to come up with custom IT marketing strategies to target specific consumers

- As a team of 4, presented a comparison presentation of explaining the difference between two computer network systems to the wireless telecommunications client in person, in order to help client make a decision for implementing the new computer network system

positions.title: Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Documented the quantity of timber products available by United Forestry Corporation in Liberia to assist the analytic team in keeping an accurate profit projections

- Analyzed the $7.42 million timber project and presented a PowerPoint presentation to advise the superiors of the risks caused by the high volatility in the timber market, and contributed to the company’s final decision to exit the timber market

educations.fieldOfStudy: Business and Management with a minor in General Psychology

projects.title: AutoLingo (Fullstack Developer)
projects.description:
AutoLingo is a web application where users can connect to other users around the world and overcome language barriers. By utilizing the Web Speech Recognition API, AutoLingo transcribes and translates text as the user speaks. The transcribed text will render on a live chat box.

• Responsible for designing entire site with CSS and implementing Mapbox and Leaflet.

• Built the live-chat component, one of the core components of the application with React, Redux and socket.io.

• Built backend models, routes, validations and tests using Sequelize, Mocha, and Chai.

projects.title: NYC Wifi Finder (Fullstack Developer)
projects.description:
NYC Free Wifi Finder is a web application, which allow users to search free wifi zones in NYC with location name or address. 

• Using free wifi zones data from NYC Open Data source, free wifi zones will be shown in blue wifi markers on the map and users will be able to see the name of the wifi, address, and coordinates of the location by clicking on the wifi markers. 

• The web application will save and show users' search histories with location name, address, and date & time the searches  were conducted. 

• JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Google Map API and NYC free wifi zones data from NYC Open Data source have been used to build the web application.
